question: why do 59.8% of Stage-0 reference labels carry no text
answer: they are cc_recovered components, never seen by the recognizer; roughly half are not text at all but dashed-line and hatch segments

label_populations.note: every label without text is cc_recovered; every OCR label has text

rejected_hypothesis_ocr_recognition.claim: the crops are legible text the numeral-tuned OCR rejected
rejected_hypothesis_ocr_recognition.test: easyocr recognize() on padded/upscaled crops, ensemble over 5 preprocessing variants
rejected_hypothesis_ocr_recognition.verdict: REJECTED as the primary fix: the recognizer assigns digits to non-text with high confidence -- a vertical dash reads as '1' at 0.97, a small circle as '0' at 1.00. Recognising these would fabricate reference numerals out of geometry.

rejected_filter_collinear_runs.claim: a dash is one of three alike blobs evenly spaced on a line, a numeral is not
rejected_filter_collinear_runs.test: flag rate on cc_recovered vs on OCR-confirmed numerals, pooled per figure
rejected_filter_collinear_runs.verdict: REJECTED: evenly spaced numerals along a row or around a part are a normal patent layout, so the signature does not discriminate. No parameter setting separated the populations.

accepted_filter_elongation.feature: aspect ratio of cv2.minAreaRect around the candidate component
accepted_filter_elongation.why: favours recall because the two failure directions are not symmetric: keeping a dash deletes drawing content, while rejecting a numeral only leaves it in the drawing to be vectorized
accepted_filter_elongation.not_addressed: small circular features (holes, pins) are not elongated and still pass; they need a separate circularity test

accepted_merge_clipped_fragments.rule: fold a candidate into an abutting read label when the widened rectangle contains no further ink

why_emptiness_test_not_gap_bound.verdict: a gap bound alone would delete geometry on roughly two thirds of pairs, so the merge is gated on measured emptiness

geometry_regression.note: content that was previously deleted is now present and must be accounted for by the geometry validator; keeping it is the point, so this cost is accepted rather than tuned away

validation_run.verdict: The fix does what it was designed to do -- 436 fewer pieces of drawing content deleted -- and does NOT materially unblock acceptance. unknown_reference_text moved 81 -> 80 because the contract requires every label on a figure to be identified and the median figure still carries 8 unidentified ones.
